muscles.note: Purple is a qualitative teaching hierarchy, not a measured activation map. Deep hip flexors are not drawn through the skin.

reviewFindings: Three native generated poses. Frame 4 holds 3, frame 5 returns through 2, and frame 6 returns to 1; six separate files, no claim of six unique poses.
The middle pose rises farther than requested. Its cue describes a partial raise, not a measured joint angle.
Native still review: both grips maintained, straight legs rise toward hip height, no visible upper-body swing, and stable purple abs/pale oblique hierarchy.
Four fixed grip/bar-joint patches have zero best-fit integer translation across the three unique poses. Shading changes remain; this is not proof of every anatomical dimension.

Actual player at 393x852 passed all six frame loads, both themes, 6-to-1 loop, cue agreement, 44px controls, no horizontal overflow and reduced-motion stepping. The three unique displayed poses in both themes were inspected.
Kept as a draft: delivery WebPs, card cutout, production cue/registry entries and final delivered-asset release evidence have not been created.

frames.caption: HANG AND BRACE 1/6
frames.cue: Hang with straight arms and brace to stop any swing.

frames.caption: BEGIN RAISE 2/6
frames.cue: Lift both straight legs forward slowly without kicking.

frames.caption: REACH PARALLEL 3/6
frames.cue: Raise your legs to hip height while keeping your torso steady.

frames.caption: HOLD CONTROL 4/6
frames.cue: Pause briefly with your abs braced and no swinging.

frames.caption: LOWER SLOWLY 5/6
frames.cue: Lower both legs together under control.

frames.caption: RETURN TO HANG 6/6
frames.cue: Finish below your hips without kicking your legs behind you.
